title: Advanced Assistant Professor or Associate Professor - Econometrics and AI Policy
industry: Public Economics & Economic Policy (JEL H), Economics, Economics and Social Sciences, Econometrics, Statistics and Quantitative Methods (JEL C)
text:
Location: Emory University Atlanta campus
Open Date: Aug 28, 2026
Description: Econometrics and AI Policy (JEL Code: C, E6, J2, J6, K3, L5, O3)
The Department of Economics at Emory University invites applications for a faculty position in Econometrics and AI Policy at the (advanced) Assistant Professor or Associate Professor level, beginning August 1, 2027. We welcome candidates whose research connects econometric methods with artificial intelligence, economic policy, digital markets, innovation, or the economic consequences and regulation of emerging technologies. Expertise in teaching Artificial Intelligence, Economic Policy, Emerging Technologies, and Innovation Policy will be essential.
Emory University, located in Atlanta, Georgia—one of the nation’s most vibrant and cosmopolitan cities—is consistently ranked among the top institutions of higher education in the United States. The Department of Economics has experienced significant growth in both size and reputation over the past decade and continues to build toward becoming one of the leading departments in the country. The successful candidate must have a Ph.D. in Economics or related fields; a distinguished record of scholarly achievement, demonstrated by publications in leading journals; an active research agenda; and a strong record of teaching excellence and mentorship at the undergraduate and/or graduate levels. Salary is competitive.
